notes.title: Proofread the game into Korean, Italian, Japanese, Thai and Czech
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42153694/bbd166b9e0dfa5c75ba9f2f3cabf19d2658449ea.png

Hey FreshMen,

Our fans translated the game into 8 languages, and we need more people to translate the game into 5 more languages, so more people will be able to play in:


 Korean
 Italian
 Japanese
 Thai
 Czech


To organize the translation project, I created a page on Crowdin, where you can translate the game directly from your browser, without having to install anything.

Crowdin offers over 10,000 screenshots, Machine Translation, Spellchecker and a place to discuss whether the translation is good or not.

You can help us in several ways:


 You can upvote or downvote machine translation.
 You can suggest better translations.
 Not only that, but you may become a proofreader, so you can QA and approve the best translations that will be in the game.
 Invite your friends to give us a boost.


If you are interested, click the link below to join the Translation Page:

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1350650/view/3376028523046606521

notes.title: Two new recruits in one week!
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40715026/c60de9eb05d6070029d26f59e19abeb1b94993eb.jpg

Hey Guys!

Last month, we earned over $26,000 thanks to Season 1 being 75% done.

The team is feeling reinvigorated, and I had to reinvest the extra cash into making the game even better for you.

We are now 9 people making FreshWomen full-time

One of the recruits is a full-time programmer (which was my job at the start of the project). He is bringing many fresh ideas, including a project to upgrade our 3D animation pipeline. He’s a bright young man, and I’m happy that I found him.

The other recruit is a writer who sent us a story that engaged me from start to finish. Our one writer was getting overloaded, and I felt we needed one extra guy to handle the tasks.

We still have enough cash for one extra hire

I’m still figuring out what will be the tenth role in our team. I think it might be someone who is a specialist in scenarios and outfits.

_______________________________________________

Rember to wishlist FreshWomen: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1350650/FreshWomen__Season_1/

Thanks for being with us on this journey.

We invested your support back into the game.

Cheers,

Oppai-Man
